name: 06073 · S Glastonbury, CT
findings: ZIP 06073 (S Glastonbury) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (58%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06073 (S Glastonbury) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
